title: Student Technology Device Program Regulation on the Number of Device Loans
content:
**Regulation.** Under the Student Technology Device Program, a household may hold device loans for any number of its students, and each loan covers one device for one school year. A device is checked out only when the student has no other open loan of the same device type for the same school year in status checked out, in repair or reported lost. A student may hold one learning device (Chromebook, iPad or Windows laptop) and, under the program's household hotspot rule, the household may hold a hotspot.

## What the regulation fixes

- **Per household**: there is no limit on the number of device loans a household holds across its students.
- **Per loan**: one device, one school year.
- **Per student, device type and school year**: at most 1 open loan. A loan is open while its status is checked out, in repair or reported lost; a loan in status returned or charged off is not open.
- **Whose records decide**: the program's loan records, read before the checkout, for the same student, the same school year and the same device type (Chromebook, iPad, Windows laptop or mobile hotspot).

## The checkout condition broken down

| Condition | Judgement | Result for the one-open-loan condition |
|---|---|---|
| The student has another loan of the same device type for the same school year in status checked out | Open loan exists | Not met; the device is not checked out |
| The same, in status in repair | Open loan exists | Not met; the device is not checked out |
| The same, in status reported lost | Open loan exists | Not met; the device is not checked out |
| The student's only other loans of that device type for that school year are in status returned or charged off | No open loan | Met |
| The student's other open loan is of a different device type, or is for a different school year | Not the same object | Met |

## Hypothetical cases

- A hypothetical household with three students holds a Chromebook loan for each: three loans, one per student, each for one device and one school year; the number of loans is not limited.
- A hypothetical student whose Chromebook loan for a school year was reported lost is not checked out a second Chromebook for that same school year while that loan stays in status reported lost.
- A hypothetical student whose Chromebook loan for a school year has been returned meets the one-open-loan condition for a new Chromebook loan in that school year.
